Marketing Manager

Requirements
- 5+ years in B2B marketing
- Proven track record in demand generation and content marketing
- Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce
- Strong grasp of SEO and SEM
- Experience running A/B testing and conversion rate optimization programmes
- Fluency with Google Analytics and reporting on CLV and NPS
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field

Nice to have
- Experience with Marketo
- Familiarity with email marketing automation
- Background in social media marketing
